t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Tse xo sa khe khoa ǁ‖ha, ǁ‖Kama kha khi di be, kha tsae qxo khe a ts’ao ta tsa a kha, ta tsa tsaoama kha. Khe khoa dǂkum nǀngi ǀkam, khi kha tsaa sa tsa kha khedi se he, khi kha ǀxo m xa tas kha khobe se he. ǁ‖Kama hka ǀkú be ha be tsa ǀkwi‘e, xwe kxam tsa se‘ua, qx’oe kha tsa ǀkwidi s kha.
